summary: Replaces every occurrence of a text on one slide.
description: Slides offers find-and-replace across a whole presentation; this narrows it to a single slide, which is what filling one templated page at a time needs. Matching is case-sensitive unless told otherwise.

params.replaceText: The text to put in its place.
params.matchCase: Whether the search is case-sensitive. `true` by default.

throws.SlideNotFoundException: the first argument is not a slide.
